aboutSample: This is demo data for now: brand names are made up and prices are not real.
aboutPrices: The brand price (MRP) and the Jan Aushadhi price are both shown for the same pack. Where the government has set a maximum price, we show that too. Prices are indicative and may differ at the shop.
aboutAiTitle: What the AI does — and does not
aboutAi: In photo scan, the AI (Gemma) only reads the name printed on the strip. The generic name, strength and prices always come from our data, never from the AI. If a name is not in our data, we say “not found” — we never guess.
aboutPrivacy: Before sending, the photo is shrunk on your phone and details like its location are removed. The photo is never saved or written to logs. Your prescription list stays on your phone only.
aboutReport: If a name or price looks wrong, tell us — we will check the source and fix it.
